summary_en: This study tests elranatamab in people with relapsed or refractory AL amyloidosis. It is a Phase I/II study. Elranatamab is given under the skin in 28-day cycles, for 6 cycles total. The study measures safety, tolerability and efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa elranatamab en personas con amiloidosis AL recidivante o refractaria. Es un estudio de Fase I/II. Elranatamab se administra debajo de la piel en ciclos de 28 días, por un total de 6 ciclos. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia.
who_for: Diagnosed with AL amyloidosis that has relapsed or not responded after at least one prior line of therapy.
Light chain disease progression, with dFLC above 20 mg/L.
Age 18 or older, with ECOG status 2 or better, or Karnofsky score of 60% or more.
Blood counts, liver function and kidney function within the limits the record defines.
Prior treatment with daratumumab plus CyBorD.
not_for: Prior BCMA-targeting bispecific antibody or BCMA-targeting CAR-T therapy.
Refractory to belantamab mafodotin, or belantamab as the most recent prior line.
Active cancer or malignancy, with listed exceptions.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study.
Heart problems such as LVEF below 30%, recent acute coronary syndrome, or uncontrolled arrhythmias.
